test_island.law: CPU-only tests NEVER mark hardware validation; the device battery hard-requires a real device (require_device gate, tested)

kernel.route: numba.cuda jit, one thread per origin
kernel.order: strict left-to-right filtered fold per origin (the N00 native Phase C order): reach += w; ge += w/exp(beta*max(pos,0)); gl += w*(1-1/(1+exp(-gr*(d-plateau-mid)))) with pos=d-plateau; knn crop k=min(kept, len(knn_weights)) insertion-sorted by (d, FILTERED index) - a total key order, so the sorted result is unique and algorithm-independent; decay branches mirror the delivered fold exactly
forbidden_absent: dense O x D x jobs tensors
kernel.scratch: exact-size nnz device arrays; each thread owns only its own slice segment [indptr[o], indptr[o+1]) - bounded by construction
kernel.device_transcendentals: libdevice exp used in-kernel; NOT assumed bit-equal to host libm - G11 validates per profile before any admission

engagement_law.static: no delivery module under Engines/ references _gpu_fold or gpu_replay_fold (test re-proves on this tree)
engagement_law.dynamic: fresh interpreter importing urban_network_analysis.batch + .Engines loads NO _gpu_fold module (re-proven by this composer, stdout CLEAN)
engagement_law.consequence: production route is unchanged; the device fold exists for the battery and G11 only

typed_blocker.law: without a device, gpu_replay_fold raises GpuUnavailable naming a blocker and 'NOT passed'; refusals (dtype/shape/endpoints/finite/Phase B) fire typed and precede the device gate

cpu_substitute_plumbing_smoke.note: UNA_GPU_BATTERY_CPU_SUBSTITUTE=1 replaces the device call with the N00 native bridge to prove the battery PLUMBING on CPU: matrix/walls/compare/JSON all exercised; self-comparison 5/5 equal (same bridge on both sides, expected) and strict-vs-numba divergence pattern consistent with the N00 map (rep4000 0/4 outputs equal; small-n class partial). This is NOT device evidence.

device_status.statement: unrun gates per gpu_region.json: no GPU bits, no GPU walls, no GPU engagement, no capability claim until G11 executes on real hardware

g11_plan.command: salloc -p gpu-v100 --gres=gpu:1 -c 4 -t 00:45:00 bash -lc 'module load cuda/12.6.1 && ./_py tests/tenx/gpu/_device_battery.py'
g11_plan.measures: device fingerprint, cold JIT, bit matrix vs native strict + delivered numba on rep/dupdist/small-empty-mid classes x 3 decays, warm full-service AB/BA walls vs the numba driver on the SAME node at C=1
g11_plan.decision_rule: choose CPU when the complete GPU region loses on measured crossover or fails the bit law; GPU walls never feed the CPU 10x gate (hardware addition, recorded separately)
